# wupclient.py: credit and license

`wupclient.py` in this folder is a modified copy of `wupserver/wupclient.py` from **iosuhax** by
**smealum**: https://github.com/smealum/iosuhax

The original says it "may or may not be inspired by plutoo's ctrrpc". catr's changes are listed in
`PROVENANCE.json` next to this file.
